name: PT Bakrie Sumatera Plantations Tbk
summary: PT Bakrie Sumatera Plantations Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the plantation, processing, and trading of agricultural and industrial products in Indonesia and internationally. It operates through Palm Oil and Derivatives and Rubber segments. The company is involved in the development and maintenance of palm oil for use in the food and non-food industry, such as cooking oil, margarine, ice cream, soaps, and detergents, as well as animal feed, cosmetics, industrial lubricants, and biofuels.
